notes.title: Development Progress Report
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone 👋[/p][p]
Here’s a little update on our latest progress! Chapter 2 is now basically complete, while Chapters 3 and 4 are still in active development. [/p][p]This time, we’re also sharing some clips of the investigation and interaction gameplay, so you can get a feel for the atmosphere as the story unfolds.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601794/cd34e9c18f51826c68ab813c5b1b0c85422792c3.png"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, the draft script for Chapter 5 is also being polished, and we’ve got plenty of surprises planned that we’ll reveal along the way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601794/2c95e9fea7f5aac1f8e9505b264511a2758267d6.png"][/img][/p][p]For now, let’s take a look at the new screenshots we’ve prepared![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "Wandering Soul"Crowdfunding is here~~
notes.content:
Hello, Players!
This is the production team of "Wandering Soul"! I'm here with exciting updates on our game's crowdfunding campaign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601794/feab550c6cad59da7e213fcec923fd7a706e7a68.jpg[/img]

We are currently developing the game "Wandering Soul", which was officially initiated in mid-2024. From the very beginning, we've been dedicated to blending elements of supernatural folklore with modern game narratives, striving to explore an entirely new way of storytelling.

This project is strongly supported by our dear friend—"大口大口吃米饭", a well-known content creator on Bilibili. He not only wrote the script for the game but also contributed his voice acting, beautifully capturing the iconic style of his video creations.

Through the medium of gaming, we aim to bring his incredible imagination to life once again. Alongside this, the game will feature original music, stunning art CGs, and innovative gameplay mechanics as we explore new possibilities between narrative and interaction.

However, this pursuit of originality and quality has inevitably increased the development timeline and costs for "Wandering Soul". To take this work further and hear more from the players, we have decided to launch a crowdfunding campaign.

At present, the crowdfunding page for "Wandering Soul" has been released and is now in the pre-launch phase. The campaign will officially start on June 9th, which is next Monday! If you're excited about "Wandering Soul", or you're interested in games inspired by supernatural folklore, we warmly invite you to offer your support!

This is our first time using crowdfunding as a way to engage with the community. There may be areas where we fall short, and we sincerely welcome your feedback and suggestions. We will actively adjust and improve, striving to make "Wandering Soul" a memorable creation.

Here is the link to the crowdfunding page:

https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/146229

Thank you so much for your support! Let's work together to bring "Wandering Soul" to life!

Feel free to let me know if you need further refinements or adjustments!
